claim.excerpt: Our aim was therefore to establish an efficient and robust liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS–MS) method based on easily available (low-end) instrumentation enabling the simultaneous determination of THC, 11-OH-THC, THC-COOH, HHC, and CBD in plasma and whole-blood.

sources.title: Quantification of ∆9-tetrahydrocannabinol, 11-OH-THC, THC-COOH, hexahydrocannabinol, and cannabidiol in human plasma and blood by liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry

why_it_matters: Links the substance to an analytical technique; does not imply a validated method for any laboratory.
